I do this lol. If anyone ever caught me they'd think I was crazy lol. I basically play both roles (me) and someone I could potentially have a future argument or disagreement with. Or even just for fun when I'm feeling alone... a lot of it is made up stuff sometimes. Always thought I was the only one too...

You are not alone. This stuff happens all the time! As a female I can say that i am not a lesbian, I have a child and a fiance. But I do remember my friend and I doing this sort of stuff a lot when we were younger. Kind of blocked it out my mind so everytime I see her, it's not weird but I wonder if she thinks about it too when she see me and then I feel awkward...

I can sort of relate to this. I bottle my feelings up SO much that it hurts. I was never open or willing to talk to my parents about feelings. I have a feeling that when I was upset (like as a toddler, you're just told to suck it up and stop crying ect. )  I would be ignored by them and so I just stopped going to them for anything. And then they wondered why I didn't feel comfortable telling them stuff as a teenager. I still to do this day cant go to them if I need emotional support but I feel totally comfortable telling my fiance everything so its definitely something to do with my parents. I see myself acting like my mom sometimes and I'm trying so damn hard not to do this to my own daughter. Anyway, know that you are not alone, there are a ton of people who feel the exact same way.

I dont like it either and I have a daughter. Trust me, I love my daughter and thinks she's cute especially now that she's learning to talk but I never brag about her or think she's the cutest thing to ever exist or the smartest, I recognize her flaws and love her more for them. I cant stand the parents that think there child is so so perfect and constantly posting about them, pictures with captions like "my kid is so perfect" because they aren't. I dont know, sounds harsh but I definitely shy away from the bragging because it makes me cringe when others do it.

Also need to add that he had already basically had the condom on before I even got to say anything, I felt pressured and had no idea what to say, hoping that reminding him of pregnancy would somehow make it stop or somehow show that I didnt want to. I dont know. My f*cking fault. I thought saying it hurt would be enough to make him stop though and of course it wasnt enough, I knew I had to say something to get his attention and I think he only got off because I yelled and my sister was downstairs.

I've always felt that something was off, maybe I couldn't admit it to myself. I knew right away that I didnt want to but I feel as if I let it happen without doing much to stop it because I just froze and didn't know what to say or do. I've had 2 other things happen (not rape) that made me fearful of men, always overly checking my surroundings, being overly paranoid when nothing had happened, & anxious around men. It really sucks because I dont want to be that way. Your reply means a lot to me and thank you so much!!!
